englishDefinition: A soft grey or green growth that appears on damp walls, food, or cloth.
example: Damp walls and a broken window have left a patch of mildew in the room.
examplePersian: دیوارهای نمناک و پنجرهٔ شکسته لکه‌ای از کپک در اتاق به‌جای گذاشته‌اند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A person whose sexual interests are regarded as abnormal.
persianMeaning: منحرف جنسی؛ کسی با میل جنسی نامتعارف
example: The word pervert has been used loosely to insult anyone who acts oddly.
examplePersian: این واژه به‌صورت آزاد برای توهین به هر کسی که عجیب رفتار کند به کار رفته است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: کم‌حرف، ساکت و محتاط در بیان نظر
englishDefinition: Disinclined to talk freely about what you think, feel or know.
example: The director was reticent about the reasons for the delay.
examplePersian: مدیر درباره دلایل تأخیر بسیار محتاط بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A person who is blamed and punished for the mistakes of other people.
example: The junior clerk was made a scapegoat for the whole failure.
examplePersian: کارمند تازه‌کار کریه‌سنگ تمام ناکامی معرفی شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Absent from school without permission, and avoiding lessons.
persianMeaning: غایب از مدرسه بدون اجازه؛ متغیب
example: A truant pupil rarely improves without support.
examplePersian: دانش‌آموز متغیب بدون حمایت به‌ندرت پیشرفت می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Active dislike and hostility towards someone or something.
example: Antagonism between the two groups grew over the dispute.
examplePersian: خصومت میان دو گروه بر سر اختلاف افزایش یافت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Complexion means the general colour and character of a person’s skin.
example: Her complexion has improved since she gave up smoking.
examplePersian: رنگ پوستش از زمانی که سیگار را ترک کرد بهتر شده است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Boring, repetitive work that you have to do.
example: Much of the daily drudgery is now done by machines.
examplePersian: بخش زیادی از کار روزمره اکنون به‌جای انسان با ماشین انجام می‌شود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A long period in history that is marked by important changes.
example: Steam power marked the beginning of a new epoch in transport.
examplePersian: قدرت بخار آغاز دوران تازه‌ای در حمل‌ونقل بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Used to summarise the most important point.
example: In essence, the two proposals differ only in how they are funded.
examplePersian: در جوهر، دو پیشنهاد تنها در نحوهٔ تأمین مالی تفاوت دارند.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: Easy to bend, shape, or influence, in the way that soft metal is.
example: Gold is so malleable that a single gram can be drawn into a long wire.
examplePersian: طلا آن‌قدر شکل‌پذیر است که یک گرم از آن را می‌توان به سیمی بلند تبدیل کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The outer edge of an area, or the position of someone who feels outside a group.
persianMeaning: پیرامون؛ حاشیهٔ یک ناحیه یا گروه
example: The villages on the periphery received the internet connection last.
examplePersian: روستاهای پیرامون آخرین جایی بودند که به اینترنت متصل شدند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Strong and well built, and able to survive hard conditions or sudden change.
example: The robust design has worked in every climate.
examplePersian: طراحی مستحکم در هر آب و هوایی کار کرده است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The process by which a gland or cell produces and releases a substance such as a hormone.
example: Excess salt intake affects the secretion of hormones in the kidneys.
examplePersian: مصرف بیش از حد نمک بر ترشح هورمون‌ها در کلیه‌ها تأثیر می‌گذارد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Able to be defended or argued against successfully.
persianMeaning: قابل دفاع؛ که بتوان از آن دفاع کرد
example: The government's claim is no longer tenable after this study.
examplePersian: پس از این مطالعه، ادعای دولت دیگر قابل دفاع نیست.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Large enough to be noticed or measured.
example: There has been an appreciable fall in birth rates.
examplePersian: کاهش قابل‌توجهی در نرخ تولد رخ داده است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To reach the highest point or final stage of a long process.
example: The talks culminated in a historic agreement last week.
examplePersian: مذاکرات هفته گذشته به توافقی تاریخی انجامید.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To say publicly that you strongly regret something you consider wrong.
example: Human rights groups deplored the decision to close the camps.
examplePersian: گروه‌های حقوق بشری تصمیم برای بستن اردوگاه‌ها را محکوم کردند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Far too high or too large, especially in cost.
example: The project was delayed by exorbitant building costs.
examplePersian: پروژه به دلیل هزینه‌های بسیار زیاد ساختمان به تأخیر افتاد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Instead of something, or in addition to something else.
example: Vegetarians received cheese in lieu of meat.
examplePersian: گیاه‌خواران به جای گوشت پنیر دریافت کردند.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: A particular way of speaking or behaving that a person keeps repeating.
example: The report criticises his mannerism of answering every question with a joke.
examplePersian: گزارش عادت او در پاسخ دادن به هر پرسش با شوخی را نقد می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: پیش‌درآمد، رویدادی پیش از رویدادی مهم‌تر
englishDefinition: An event or activity that comes before and prepares for a more important one.
example: The early trial is only a prelude to a much longer investigation.
examplePersian: این دادگاهی اولیه تنها پیش‌درآمدی برای تحقیقات بسیار طولانی‌تر است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Used to say that something is true whatever the circumstances.
example: All entries are judged regardless of which country the candidate is from.
examplePersian: همهٔ آثار بدون توجه به کشور داوطلب ارزیابی می‌شوند.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: To begin to grow small shoots or leaves from a seed, a bulb or a stem.
example: The potatoes sprouted in the dark cupboard within a few weeks.
examplePersian: سیب‌زمینی‌ها در چند هفته در کابینت تاریک جوانه زدند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Shyness and a lack of confidence in unfamiliar situations.
example: His timidity disappeared once he had spoken at the first meeting.
examplePersian: کم‌روئی او پس از سخنرانی در نخستین جلسه ناپدید شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A measure that is too crude to achieve a precise result.
example: A blunt instrument such as a total ban rarely improves compliance.
examplePersian: ابزاری کند مانند ممنوعیت کامل، به‌ندرت پایبندی را بهبود می‌دهد.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: A carcase is the dead body of an animal, ready to be cut up as meat.
example: The butchers hung the sheep carcases in the cold room.
examplePersian: قصاب‌ها لاشه‌های گوسفند را در سردخانه آویختند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To work out the meaning of something that is written in code or is hard to read.
example: Historians spent years trying to decipher the damaged manuscript.
examplePersian: مورخان سال‌ها تلاش کردند نسخه آسیب‌دیده را رمزگشایی کنند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Lasting for a very short time only.
example: Social media has created an ephemeral culture of endless distraction.
examplePersian: رسانه‌های اجتماعی فرهنگی گذرا از بی‌پایانی حواس‌پرتی ساخته‌اند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Taking a particular fact or event into account when considering something.
example: In light of recent floods, the council has revised its drainage plan.
examplePersian: با توجه به سیل‌های اخیر، شورا طرح زهکشی خود را بازنگری کرده است.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: To have a wrong idea about something, or to misunderstand what somebody means.
example: Many people misconceive the study and think that it is a waste of time.
examplePersian: بسیاری از مردم این پژوهش را بد فهمیده و گمان می‌کنند که هدر دادن وقت است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Forming a right angle with a horizontal line.
example: The two rails are absolutely perpendicular to the platform.
examplePersian: دو ریل کاملاً عمود بر سکو هستند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Compared with another amount or situation.
example: Costs have risen sharply relative to household income.
examplePersian: هزینه‌ها نسبت به درآمد خانوار به‌شدت افزایش یافته است.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: The solid waste that is left after metal is separated from the ore in which it is found.
example: Slag from the iron works is reused in the production of cement.
examplePersian: سرباره‌ی کوره‌ی آهن در تولید سیمان دوباره استفاده می‌شود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Showing something clearly, as a sign or piece of evidence.
persianMeaning: گویا؛ نشانه‌ای که چیزی را آشکار می‌کند
example: The gap between the two graphs is a telling sign of neglect.
examplePersian: فاصله میان دو نمودار نشانه‌ای گویا از بی‌توجهی است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A clear example that proves the point being made.
example: The abandoned mill is a case in point for long-term industrial decline.
examplePersian: کارخانهٔ متروکه نمونهٔ بارزی برای زوال بلندمدت صنعت است.
collocations: a case in point is X
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: Concerted means planned or done by several people working together.
example: The plan failed because there was no concerted effort to raise money.
examplePersian: این طرح شکست خورد چون تلاش دست‌جمعی برای جذب وجوه وجود نداشت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Very old and in poor condition, especially a building or vehicle.
example: The decrepit farmhouse was scheduled for demolition.
examplePersian: آن خانه فرسوده برای تخریب در نظر گرفته شده بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To use or consume a limited amount of something.
example: The project expended most of its funds on training.
examplePersian: این پروژه بیشتر بودجه خود را صرف آموزش کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: In agreement with a rule, standard or expectation.
example: The revised figures are in line with official statistics.
examplePersian: ارقام بازنگری‌شده با آمار رسمی هم‌راستا است.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: To treat a person or an animal badly, especially in a cruel way.
example: The report says that many young animals were maltreated on those farms.
examplePersian: گزارش می‌گوید بسیاری از حیوانات جوان در آن مزارع بد رفتاری شدند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The size and shape of a person's body.
example: He built an impressive physique through daily training.
examplePersian: او با تمرین روزانه اندامی متناسب و چشمگیر ساخت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A simple practical guideline rather than a strict rule.
example: As a rule of thumb, allow six months of preparation per band.
examplePersian: به‌عنوان قاعده‌ای سرانگشتی، برای هر نمره شش ماه زمان آمادگی در نظر بگیرید.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: The outward appearance of something, which may not represent the reality.
example: The building has the semblance of a castle but serves as offices.
examplePersian: این ساختمان ظاهر یک قصر را دارد اما به‌عنوان دفتر به کار می‌رود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To break a rule or go beyond what is permitted.
persianMeaning: زیر پا گذاشتن قانون؛ از حد مجاز گذشتن
example: The company transgressed safety rules to save money.
examplePersian: شرکت برای صرفه‌جویی در هزینه، قواعد ایمنی را زیر پا گذاشت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A comparison group that receives no treatment.
example: Each trial compared the drug with a control group of placebos.
examplePersian: هر آزمایش دارو را با یک گروه شاهد از دارونماها مقایسه کرد.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: To bend your body down low, with your legs bent under you.
example: The child crouched down to pick up the toy.
examplePersian: کودک خم شد تا اسباب‌بازی را بردارد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To use up a supply of something so that none is left.
example: Years of drought have depleted the region's groundwater reserves.
examplePersian: سال‌ها خشکسالی ذخایر آب زیرزمینی منطقه را تخلیه کرده است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Growing or speaking with great energy and joy.
example: The garden was filled with exuberant spring flowers.
examplePersian: باغ پر از گل‌های بهاری سرشار از شادی بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: در موقعیتی نبودن که؛ ناتوان از
englishDefinition: Not able to do something because of circumstances or lack of right.
example: Without funding the team was in no position to continue the trial.
examplePersian: بدون بودجه، تیم در موقعیتی نبود که بتواند آزمایش را ادامه دهد.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: A very small world in which the larger whole is represented, like a small model of it.
example: The island is a microcosm of the whole country's problems.
examplePersian: این جزیره نمونهٔ کوچکی از مشکلات کل کشور است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: More numerous, more common or more influential than other things in a group.
example: Rice is still the predominant crop across most of the region.
examplePersian: برنج هنوز در بیشتر نقاط این منطقه محصول غالب است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: منتفی کردن؛ رد کردن؛ کنار گذاشتن
englishDefinition: To eliminate a possibility, or to prevent something from being allowed.
example: Researchers have not ruled out contamination of the water supply.
examplePersian: پژوهشگران آلودگی منابع آب را منتفی اعلام نکرده‌اند.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: To take one number or amount away from a larger one.
example: Subtract the tax from the total before you compare the two prices.
examplePersian: پیش از مقایسه‌ی دو قیمت، مالیات را از مبلغ کل کم کنید.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Treating similar situations in different, unfair ways.
example: Applying a double standard to two states is widely condemned.
examplePersian: اعمال استاندارد دوگانه بر دو کشور به‌طور گسترده محکوم می‌شود.
collocations: what appears to be a double standard
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: Conducive to something means likely to encourage it.
example: A quiet room is more conducive to study than a noisy kitchen.
examplePersian: اتاقی ساکت بیش از آشپزخانه پرسروصدا به مطالعه کمک می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To become gradually weaker or smaller until it disappears.
example: The heat of the debate dissipated once both sides had spoken.
examplePersian: گرمای مناظره پس از سخنرانی طرفین فروکش کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: خسته و کلافه کردن از حد
englishDefinition: To annoy someone so much that they lose patience.
example: Customers were exasperated by the endless automated menu.
examplePersian: مشتریان از منوی خودکار و بی‌پایان کلافه شده بودند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Trying hard to achieve or obtain something.
example: Several species are being killed in pursuit of higher yields.
examplePersian: چند گونه در راه دستیابی به بازده بیشتر کشته می‌شوند.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: Not enough in amount, quality, or size for what is actually needed.
example: The report describes a meagre diet for most of the rural children.
examplePersian: گزارش رژیم غذایی ناکافی بیشتر کودکان روستایی را توصیف می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A heavy weight that swings slowly from side to side in a clock.
example: The pendulum of public opinion finally swung towards reform.
examplePersian: آونگ افکار عمومی سرانجام به سمت اصلاحات متمایل شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A detailed account of facts, given by someone at length.
example: The witness gave a long recital of the events of that night.
examplePersian: شاهد شرح مفصلی از رویدادهای آن شب ارائه کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Unwilling to believe something until you have seen good evidence that it is true.
example: Most doctors remained sceptical about the claim of the supplement.
examplePersian: بیشتر پزشکان نسبت به ادعای این مکمل تردید داشتند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: شمشیر دولبه؛ چیزی که هم سود هم زیان دارد
englishDefinition: An advantage that also creates a new problem.
example: Automation is a double-edged sword for the manufacturing sector.
examplePersian: اتوماسیون برای بخش تولید شمشیر دولبه است.
collocations: prove to be a double-edged sword
is something of a double-edged sword
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: Conscientious means doing your work carefully and thoroughly because you want to.
example: She is the most conscientious nurse in the whole hospital.
examplePersian: او وظیفه‌شناسترین پرستار کل بیمارستان است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To turn something away from its usual direction or course.
example: He tried to deflect criticism by blaming the previous committee.
examplePersian: او با مقصر دانستن کمیته پیشین، تلاش کرد انتقادها را از خود دور کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To destroy completely every member of a group.
example: Scientists worked for years to exterminate the harmful insects.
examplePersian: دانشمندان سال‌ها کار کردند تا حشرات مضر را از بین ببرند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Used to introduce the subject that is being discussed.
example: Opinions differ in regard to the timing of the change.
examplePersian: دربارهٔ زمان‌بندی این تغییر، دیدگاه‌ها متفاوت است.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: A thin sheet of film on which very small photographs of the pages of a book are recorded.
example: Old newspapers can be read on microfilm in the national library.
examplePersian: روزنامه‌های قدیمی را می‌توان در کتابخانهٔ ملی روی میکروفیلم خواند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Uncertain and unstable, so that it could easily collapse.
persianMeaning: شکننده؛ ناپایدار و در معرض خطر
example: The bridge is in such a precarious state that it may close.
examplePersian: پل در وضعیتی چنان شکننده است که ممکن است بسته شود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: طولانی و بی‌هدف حرف زدن یا نوشتن
englishDefinition: To talk or write at length without any clear direction or purpose.
example: His lecture began clearly and then rambled on for an hour.
examplePersian: سخنرانی او با وضوح آغاز شد و سپس یک ساعت بی‌هدف ادامه یافت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: An object that tells the time from the shadow cast by the sun.
example: A stone sundial in the garden still keeps good time.
examplePersian: ساعت آفتابی سنگی در باغ هنوز وقت را دقیق نشان می‌دهد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: An evaluation based on balanced and transparent criteria.

englishDefinition: A share that is large enough to matter statistically.

examplePersian: نسبت قابل توجهی از نمونه هرگز به درمانگاه مراجعه نکرده بود.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: A person whose job is to look after a building and its contents.
example: The custodian locked up the school hall at nine o'clock.
examplePersian: نگهبان ساعت نه سالن مدرسه را قفل کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A narrow pass between two hills or mountains.
example: The road runs through a defile between the two ridges.
examplePersian: جاده از گذرگاهی میان دو یال کوه عبور می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Used when something must be dealt with despite difficulty.
example: The clinic has expanded in the face of rising demand.
examplePersian: کلینیک با وجود افزایش تقاضا توسعه یافته است.
collocations: in the face of mounting pressure
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: An image of distant water or land that appears in hot air and then disappears.
example: The drivers followed a mirage across the flat desert for several hours.
examplePersian: رانندگان ساعت‌ها سرابی را در بیابان هموار دنبال کردند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: An instrument on a submarine that lets you see above the water.
example: The captain watched the coastline through the periscope.
examplePersian: سردیپ ساحل را از طریق پریسکوپ تماشا کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To send a person back to the country that they originally came from.
example: The new law allows the government to repatriate asylum seekers.
examplePersian: قانون جدید به دولت اجازه بازگرداندن پناهجویان را می‌دهد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The part of a ship that sits above the main deck and holds the bridge.
example: The ship's superstructure houses the bridge and the officers' cabins.
examplePersian: ساختمان فوقانی کشتی جای عرشه‌ی فرماندهی و کابین افسران است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A situation where gaining one thing means giving up another.
example: There is a clear trade-off between speed and accuracy.
examplePersian: مصالحهٔ روشنی میان سرعت و دقت وجود دارد.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: To coerce someone means to make them do something by force or by threats.
example: The landlord tried to coerce tenants into leaving without notice.
examplePersian: موجر کوشید مستأجران را به ترک بدون اطلاع قبلی وادارد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A person who has been abandoned by society and has no home or work.
example: Volunteers cook dinner for the derelicts who sleep in the station.
examplePersian: داوطلبان برای افراد بی‌خانمانی که در ایستگاه می‌خوابند شام می‌پزند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Used to give the reason or purpose for an action.
example: The building was restored in the name of a local philanthropist.
examplePersian: ساختمان به نام یک خیر محلی بازسازی شد.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: An area of soft wet ground, such as deep mud, that is hard to walk through.
example: After a week of rain the lane became a mire and the vans could not pass.
examplePersian: پس از یک هفته باران، کوچه به گل و مرداب تبدیل شد و کامیون‌ها نتوانستند عبور کنند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To express someone's words in a different way with the same meaning.
persianMeaning: بازنویسی؛ بیان سخنان به شکلی دیگر
example: Could you paraphrase the argument in one sentence?
examplePersian: می‌توانید استدلال را در یک جمله بازنویسی کنید؟
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: موج انداختن، چین انداختن و بر هم زدن سطح
englishDefinition: To disturb the smooth surface of water or cloth so that small waves or folds appear.
example: A light breeze ruffled the surface of the lake.
examplePersian: نسیم ملایمی سطح دریاچه را موج‌انداخت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To state as a condition that must be met in a contract or agreement.
example: The contract stipulates that payment must be made within thirty days.
examplePersian: قرارداد مقرر کرده است که پرداخت باید ظرف سی روز انجام شود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: An option that can actually work in practice.
example: Cycling is a viable alternative for short journeys.
examplePersian: دوچرخه‌سواری جایگزین عملی برای سفرهای کوتاه است.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: To reduce the length, amount or scope of something, often sharply.
example: The new law aims to curtail the use of plastic packaging.
examplePersian: قانون جدید هدفش محدود کردن استفاده از بسته‌بندی پلاستیکی است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A state of confused thinking in which a person cannot think or speak clearly.
example: High fever caused delirium in the sick child.
examplePersian: تب شدید باعث تشوش ذهنی در کودک بیمار شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: When someone or something is present.
example: The officer was warned that statements made in the presence of a witness carry more weight.
examplePersian: افسر هشدار داده شد که اظهاراتی که در حضور شاهد بیان شود وزن بیشتری دارند.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: A heavy metal chain that is fastened around a prisoner's wrists or ankles.
example: The prisoners were put in manacles and taken to court.
examplePersian: زندانیان را در بند آهنین بستند و به دادگاه بردند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Pleasant enough to eat, or acceptable to a particular group.
example: The new policy is palatable to both sides of the debate.
examplePersian: این سیاست جدید برای هر دو طرف بحث مقبول است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To provide evidence that proves that a statement or claim is true.
example: The researchers could not substantiate their claim with reliable data.
examplePersian: پژوهشگران نتوانستند ادعای خود را با داده‌های معتبر اثبات کنند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A situation in which a problem causes itself to continue.
example: Low wages and poor housing form a vicious circle.
examplePersian: دستمزد پایین و مسکن نامناسب دایره‌ای شیطانی می‌سازند.
collocations: trap families in a vicious circle
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: Harsh or unkind in tone, especially when it is used about someone's words.
example: Her cutting remarks about the report upset the whole team.
examplePersian: نکوه‌های تند او درباره گزارش، کل تیم را ناراحت کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To become wider, or to make a hole or opening wider.
example: The valve dilates slightly each time the pressure rises.
examplePersian: شیر با هر بار بالا رفتن فشار کمی باز می‌شود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: تحت نظر افکار عمومی؛ جلوی چشم مردم
englishDefinition: Receiving a great deal of attention from the public.
example: After the scandal the director was no longer really in the public eye.
examplePersian: پس از رسوایی، دیگر مدیر واقعاً در معرض دید افکار عمومی نبود.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: A feeling of worry or doubt that something may turn out badly.
example: She had serious misgivings about signing the contract without advice.
examplePersian: او دربارهٔ امضای قرارداد بدون مشورت نگرانی جدی داشت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Behaving in a proud and self-important way.
example: His pompous manner put the young staff off talking.
examplePersian: رفتار مغرورانه‌اش کارکنان جوان را از صحبت بازداشت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To move slowly and gradually through small openings or porous material.
example: Rain water began to seep through the walls of the old stone church.
examplePersian: آب باران به‌تدریج از دیوارهای کلیسای سنگی قدیمی نشت کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A repeating pattern in which each problem worsens the next.
example: Debt and low income form a vicious cycle for many households.
examplePersian: بدهی و درآمد پایین چرخه‌ای معیوب برای بسیاری از خانواده‌ها می‌سازد.
collocations: trap households in a vicious cycle
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: Consequent means following as a result of something, and therefore important.
example: The committee warned that the cuts would have a consequent effect on staffing.
examplePersian: کمیته هشدار داد که این کاهش‌ها اثر متعاقبی بر نیروی کار خواهد داشت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A complete lack of something that is needed.
example: The country suffered a dearth of clean drinking water last summer.
examplePersian: کشور تابستان گذشته با کمبود شدید آب آشامیدنی روبه‌رو شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Used to give an approximate figure or amount.
example: Repairs will cost in the region of two thousand pounds.
examplePersian: تعمیرات حدود دو هزار پوند هزینه خواهد داشت.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: To describe something wrongly, so that people form a false idea about it.
example: The advertisement misrepresents the cost of the course to new students.
examplePersian: این آگهی هزینهٔ دوره را برای دانشجویان تازه بد جلوه می‌دهد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To make someone feel completely confused and puzzled.
persianMeaning: سردرگم کردن؛ مبهم کردن برای دیگری
example: The contradictory instructions perplexed even the experienced staff.
examplePersian: دستورهای متناقض حتی کارکنان باتجربه را سردرگم کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To succeed in dealing with a serious difficulty that stood in your way.
example: The team surmounted every technical obstacle within six months.
examplePersian: تیم در ظرف شش ماه بر همه‌ی موانع فنی غلبه کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: نابرابری فزاینده؛ شکاف رو به گسترش
englishDefinition: A growing gap between the richest and poorest groups.
example: A widening inequality has hardened opposition to the reform.
examplePersian: نابرابری فزاینده مخالفت با اصلاحات را سخت‌گیرانه‌تر کرده است.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: A chasm is a deep hole, or a very large gap between two groups or ideas.
example: There is a wide chasm between the two versions of the report.
examplePersian: میان دو نسخه گزارش شکافی بزرگ وجود دارد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Failure to pay money that you owe when you should pay it.
example: The tenant lost the flat after years of rent delinquency.
examplePersian: مستأجر پس از سال‌ها بدهی اجاره، آپارتمان را از دست داد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: به همین ترتیب؛ به همان شیوه
englishDefinition: Used to show that a new point is of the same kind as an earlier one.
example: In the same vein, the neighbouring district reported similar figures.
examplePersian: به همین ترتیب، منطقهٔ همسایه نیز ارقام مشابهی گزارش کرد.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: Harmful and likely to spread, especially in the case of a tumour or a disease.
example: A benign tumour is harmless, but a malignant one can spread very quickly.
examplePersian: تومور خوش‌خیم بی‌خطر است، اما تومور بدخیم می‌تواند به‌سرعت پخش شود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: An antibiotic medicine originally made from mould.
example: Penicillin was the first widely used antibiotic.
examplePersian: پنی‌سیلین نخستین آنتی‌بیوتیک پرکاربرد بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A very poor, roughly built shelter made from cheap and waste materials.
example: A shanty town grew up beside the harbour after the earthquake.
examplePersian: پس از زلزله، شهرکی از کپرها در کنار بندر شکل گرفت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: How well a student does in their studies.
example: Sleep quality is closely linked to academic performance.
examplePersian: کیفیت خواب ارتباط نزدیکی با عملکرد تحصیلی دارد.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: A chisel is a flat metal tool with a sharp edge used for cutting stone or wood.
example: The sculptor shaped the stone with a hammer and a chisel.
examplePersian: مجسمه‌ساز سنگ را با چکش و قلم شکل داد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To swell outwards because of pressure from inside.
example: The balloon distended rapidly as the hot air went in.
examplePersian: بادون با ورود هوای گرم به‌سرعت باد کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Immediately following an event, often an unpleasant one.
example: In the wake of the scandal, several officials resigned.
examplePersian: در پی رسوایی، چند مقام استعفا دادند.
collocations: in the wake of a crisis
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: Used to say that something usually happens.
example: More often than not, these disputes are settled quietly rather than in court.
examplePersian: بیشتر اوقات این اختلافات به‌جای دادگاه، آرام حل می‌شود.
collocations: more often than not it is
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: Concerned with the physical sounds of a language.
persianMeaning: آوایی؛ مربوط به صداهای یک زبان
example: The phonetic spelling of her name helped people pronounce it.
examplePersian: املای آوایی نام او به مردم کمک کرد آن را تلفظ کنند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: باوجدان، دقیق و وسواسی در کار
englishDefinition: Very careful about doing what is right, and honest about small matters.
example: The auditor was scrupulous about every line of the accounts.
examplePersian: حسابرسی در هر سطر حساب‌ها بسیار باوجدان بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: علی‌رغم همهٔ احتمالات؛ با وجود معارض‌ها
englishDefinition: In spite of strong reasons to expect failure.
example: Against all odds, the team completed the survey on time.
examplePersian: علی‌رغم همهٔ احتمالات، تیم نظرسنجی را به‌موقع به پایان رساند.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: Coeducation is a system in which boys and girls study together in the same school.
example: Coeducation became normal in the region after the war.
examplePersian: آموزش مشترک پس از جنگ در منطقه رایج شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: با توجه به؛ با در نظر گرفتنِ
englishDefinition: Because of something that has happened or been noticed.
example: In view of the drought, the council has banned irrigation of parks.
examplePersian: با توجه به خشکسالی، شورا آبیاری پارک‌ها را ممنوع کرده است.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: Calm and peaceful, especially in a way that hides strong feelings.
example: The lake was placid in the early morning light.
examplePersian: دریاچه در نور سپیده‌دم آرام بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Designed to prevent sound from passing through walls, floors or windows.
example: The recording studio has soundproof walls that block all noise.
examplePersian: استودیوی ضبط دیوارهای عایق صدا دارد که تمام سروصدا را می‌گیرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: در نظر گرفتن؛ جایی برای در نظر گرفتن گذاشتن
englishDefinition: To consider something when making a plan or calculation.
example: The forecast does not allow for the possibility of a sudden rise in demand.
examplePersian: این پیش‌بینی احتمال افزایش ناگهانی تقاضا را در نظر نمی‌گیرد.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: A checkup is a short medical examination to find out whether you are healthy.
example: The clinic offers a free checkup to every patient over fifty.
examplePersian: کلینیک به هر بیمار بالای پنجاه سال معاینه رایگان پیشنهاد می‌دهد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Used to present an interpretation that readers could dispute.
example: It could be argued that the policy penalises rural schools.
examplePersian: می‌توان استدلال کرد که این سیاست مدارس روستایی را جریمه می‌کند.
collocations: it could be argued that X
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

persianMeaning: ناگهانی و بدون هشدار باعث وقوع چیزی شدن
englishDefinition: To make something happen suddenly and without warning.
example: The unclear statement precipitated a sharp fall in the company share price.
examplePersian: بیان مبهم شرکت باعث سقوط ناگهانی قیمت سهام آن شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: To read a text very quickly in order to get only the main points.
example: Candidates are advised to skim the question before reading the options.
examplePersian: داوطلبان توصیه می‌شوند پیش از خواندن گزینه‌ها، سؤال را سرسری بخوانند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

persianMeaning: جمعیت سالخورده؛ جمعیت در حال پیری
englishDefinition: A population whose average age is rising.
example: An ageing population places heavy pressure on pension systems.
examplePersian: جمعیت سالخورده فشار سنگینی بر سیستم‌های بازنشستگی وارد می‌آورد.
collocations: an ageing population puts pressure on
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: A long narrow gap or opening in a rock or wall.
example: A lizard hid in a crevice in the cliff face.
examplePersian: مارمولکی در شکافی از صخره پنهان شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The belief that things will turn out badly.
example: Her pessimism about the economy proved unfounded.
examplePersian: بدبینی او دربارهٔ اقتصاد بی‌اساس از آب درآمد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: سوختن سطحی، خشک کردن تا ترک بخورد و گرمازدگی
englishDefinition: To burn the surface of something lightly, or to dry it so hard that it cracks.
example: A hot dry wind scorched the young shoots in the field.
examplePersian: باد گرم و خشک نهال‌های جوان مزرعه را سوزاند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: جلب کردن علاقه؛ درخواست کردن از
englishDefinition: To attract someone's interest or support, or to make a formal request.
example: Design alone rarely appeals to the audience; price and practicality matter more.
examplePersian: طراحی به‌تنهایی به‌ندرت توجه مخاطب را جلب می‌کند؛ قیمت و کاربرد عملی مهم‌ترند.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: A weight or force that balances another one.
example: The counterbalance on the crane stopped the load from swinging.
examplePersian: وزنه تعادل روی جرثقیل از نوسان بار جلوگیری کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The people who live after you, your children and later generations.
example: The hall was restored for the benefit of posterity.
examplePersian: تالار برای بهرهٔ آیندگان مرمت شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: اشباع کردن، مملو کردن و کاملاً پر کردن
englishDefinition: To fill something completely with a liquid or with people or things, so that no more can be added.
example: Crowds saturated the narrow streets during the festival.
examplePersian: در طول جشنواره، جمعیت خیابان‌های باریک را اشباع کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Used to contrast two things that are being compared.
example: The policy rewards volume as opposed to the quality of the work.
examplePersian: این سیاست حجم کار را در مقابل کیفیت آن پاداش می‌دهد.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: Congruent means exactly the same in size and shape, or in agreement.
example: The two triangles are congruent, so they have equal areas.
examplePersian: دو مثلث همسان‌اند، بنابراین مساحت برابری دارند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: Published, awarded or done after someone's death.
persianMeaning: پس از مرگ؛ انجام‌شده پس از درگذشت
example: The novel was a huge posthumous success for its author.
examplePersian: این رمان پس از مرگ نویسنده‌اش به موفقیتی بزرگ رسید.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: نهر ماسی، جای کم‌عمق در دریا
englishDefinition: A shallow area of water, often a ridge of sand, that is dangerous for ships.
example: The boat ran aground on a shoal that appeared at low tide.
examplePersian: کشتی روی نهر ماسی‌ای که هنگام جزر پدیدار شده بود به گل نشست.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: به هر حال؛ در هر صورت
englishDefinition: Used to introduce information that does not change the main point.
example: The figures are provisional, but at any rate the trend is clear.
examplePersian: ارقام موقتی‌اند، اما به هر حال روند روشن است.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: Studying a lot of material in a very short time before an exam.
example: Last-minute cramming rarely improves exam results.
examplePersian: شبانه‌روزی درس خواندن به‌ندرت نتیجه آزمون را بهتر می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To give someone too much attention, comfort or treats.
persianMeaning: لوس کردن؛ بیش از حد رسیدگی کردن
example: He pampers his children and buys them everything.
examplePersian: او بچه‌هایش را لوس می‌کند و همه‌چیز برایشان می‌خرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To cover something completely so that air, light or sound cannot pass through.
example: Thick clouds smothered the sun for three whole days.
examplePersian: ابرهای ضخیم برای سه روز کامل خورشید را پوشاندند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: In the way something appears, without examining it further.
example: Taken at face value, the figures suggest steady growth.
examplePersian: در نگاه نخست، ارقام رشدی پیوسته را نشان می‌دهند.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

persianMeaning: خوردن، زنگ زدن، خوردگی پیدا کردن
englishDefinition: To be gradually destroyed by a chemical action such as acid or rust.
example: Salt water corrodes the metal fittings on ships very quickly.
examplePersian: آب شور اتصالات فلزی کشتی‌ها را به سرعت زنگ می‌زند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To keep trying to do something in spite of difficulties.
persianMeaning: جدایت کردن؛ با وجود مشکل ادامه دادن
example: The team persevered for three years without a single sponsor.
examplePersian: تیم سه سال بدون هیچ حامی‌ای جداجویی کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Firm and unchanging in purpose or loyalty, even under pressure.
example: Her steadfast support carried the team through a difficult season.
examplePersian: حمایت استوار او تیم را از فصلی دشوار عبور داد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To disagree with something, or to be inconsistent with a rule.
example: The proposed building is at odds with the local conservation plan.
examplePersian: ساختمان پیشنهادی با طرح محلی حفاظت از محیط در تضاد است.
collocations: be at odds with each other
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: To censor something means to remove or hide words or images before people can see them.
example: The newspaper was accused of trying to censor the interview.
examplePersian: روزنامه متهم شد که می‌کوشد مصاحبه را سانسور کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: Careful, detailed and needing a great deal of effort.
persianMeaning: زحمتکشانه؛ با دقت و تلاش بسیار
example: She made a painstaking effort to record every detail.
examplePersian: او برای ثبت هر جزئیاتی تلاشی زحمتکشانه کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: فرو رفتن زیر سطح آب، غوطه‌ور کردن
englishDefinition: To go below the surface of water, or to put something under water.
example: Marsh plants are able to survive when they are submerged for weeks.
examplePersian: گیاهان باتلاقی وقتی چند هفته زیر آب غوطه‌ور شوند زنده می‌مانند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: At risk of being lost or damaged.
example: Thousands of livelihoods are at stake in this decision.
examplePersian: هزاران شغل در این تصمیم در معرض خطرند.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: Caustic means sharp and unkind, especially about a person’s sense of humour.
example: Her caustic remarks about the new design made the team work harder.
examplePersian: نظرات تلخ او درباره طرح جدید باعث شد تیم سخت‌تر کار کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Possible to do or use in a real and workable way.
example: Building a tunnel here is technically practicable but far too costly.
examplePersian: ساخت تونل اینجا از نظر فنی عملی است اما بسیار پرهزینه است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: An idea that is accepted as true for the moment, although it is not proved.
example: The whole plan rests on the supposition that prices will stay low.
examplePersian: تمام این طرح بر فرض پایدار ماندن قیمت‌ها استوار است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Something negative is suffered so that something else can happen.
example: Growth was achieved at the cost of a sharp rise in inequality.
examplePersian: رشد به بهای افزایش شدید نابرابری به دست آمد.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: To clasp something means to hold it tightly in both hands.
example: He clasped her hand and led her towards the platform.
examplePersian: او دستش را در چنگال گرفت و او را به سمت سکو راهنمایی کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Done in small separate stages rather than all at once.
persianMeaning: تدریجی؛ کم‌کم و مرحله به مرحله
example: The restoration was carried out in piecemeal stages over ten years.
examplePersian: بازسازی طی ده سال به‌صورت تدریجی انجام شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: An extra amount of money added to a price as a fee or a penalty.
example: The airline added a surcharge for luggage above the weight limit.
examplePersian: شرکت هواپیمایی برای بار بیش از حد مجاز هزینه‌ی اضافه‌ای تعیین کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To achieve something at the loss of something else that matters.
example: Output rose steadily, but at the expense of the surrounding farmland.
examplePersian: تولید پیوسته افزایش یافت، اما به بهای زمین‌های کشاورزی پیرامون.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: To concoct something means to invent it in an unusual and clever way.
example: The cook concocted a meal from what was left in the cupboard.
examplePersian: آشپز از آنچه در کمد مانده بود غذایی سرهم کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Likely to go bad quickly, especially food.
example: Fresh cream is highly perishable and must stay refrigerated.
examplePersian: خامهٔ تازه زودفس است و باید در یخچال بماند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The official list of topics and requirements for a particular course of study.
example: Examiners set the questions strictly according to the published syllabus.
examplePersian: امتحانتازان سؤال‌ها را دقیقاً بر پایه‌ی برنامه‌ی درسی اعلام‌شده تنظیم می‌کنند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: To be among the leading organisations or people in a field.
example: The university has long been at the forefront of climate research.
examplePersian: این دانشگاه مدت‌ها در خط مقدم پژوهش‌های اقلیمی بوده است.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: To console someone means to comfort them in a difficult moment.
example: She sat quietly beside him to console him after the news.
examplePersian: پس از شنیدن خبر، آرام کنارش نشست تا دلجویی‌اش کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A short addition at the end of a letter, after the signature.
example: In a postscript she added the address of the new office.
examplePersian: او در حاشیهٔ نامه نشانی دفتر جدید را افزود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To take the place of something that came before it, making it unnecessary.
example: The new rule supersedes all previous guidance on working hours.
examplePersian: قاعده‌ی تازه جایگزین همه‌ی راهنمایی‌های پیشین درباره‌ی ساعت کاری شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To be completely dependent on something you cannot control.
example: Small farmers remain at the mercy of a volatile export market.
examplePersian: کشاورزان کوچک همچنان اسیر بازار صادراتی نوسانی هستند.
collocations: at the mercy of the weather
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: To constrain something means to limit it or restrict your freedom to act.
example: A small budget constrained what the team could test.
examplePersian: بودجه انداز تیم را در آنچه می‌توانست آزمایش کند محدود کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: To make people calm and peaceful after a conflict.
example: The ambassador was sent to pacify the angry crowd.
examplePersian: سفیر برای آرام کردن جمعیت خشمگین اعزام شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To be in charge of a place or activity and to watch over it carefully.
example: A single officer superintends the whole testing procedure.
examplePersian: یک افسر بر کل روند آزمایش نظارت می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: At the beginning of a process or period.
example: The rules were set out clearly at the outset of the trial.
examplePersian: قوانین در آغاز آزمایش به‌روشنی اعلام شدند.
collocations: at the outset of the study
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

persianMeaning: رسمی گرد هم آمدن، تشکیل جلسه دادن
englishDefinition: To gather a group of people for an official meeting.
example: The committee will convene in Geneva next month.
examplePersian: کمیته ماه آینده به طور رسمی در ژنو تشکیل جلسه خواهد داد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To spread throughout a place or through a material.
persianMeaning: نفوذ در سراسر؛ در همه‌جا گسترش یافتن
example: The smell of coffee permeated the whole building.
examplePersian: بوی قهوه در سراسر ساختمان پیچیده بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

persianMeaning: شروع کردن به؛ دست به کار شدن
englishDefinition: To begin doing something that takes effort.
example: The council set about reviewing the whole planning system.
examplePersian: شورا کار بازبینی کل نظام برنامه‌ریزی را آغاز کرد.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: To be different from, or in conflict with, an accepted statement.
example: The revised figures are at variance with the earlier published data.
examplePersian: ارقام بازنگری‌شده با داده‌های منتشرشدهٔ پیشین ناهمخوان است.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

persianMeaning: فراخوان دادن؛ خواستار بودن؛ ایجاب کردن
englishDefinition: To demand that something happen, or to need something urgently.
example: The report calls for stricter limits on industrial emissions.
examplePersian: این گزارش خواستار اعمال محدودیت‌های سخت‌گیرانه‌تر بر انتشار صنعتی است.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: Easily bent, or easily persuaded to change your opinion.
example: The pipe is too pliable to carry hot water safely.
examplePersian: لوله آن‌قدر انعطاف‌پذیر است که آب داغ را ایمن منتقل نمی‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: کنار گذاشتن؛ ذخیره کردن؛ نادیده گرفتن
englishDefinition: To reserve money or time, or to ignore something temporarily.
example: The government set aside a portion of revenue for rural clinics.
examplePersian: دولت بخشی از درآمد را برای درمانگاه‌های روستایی کنار گذاشت.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

persianMeaning: رسیدگی کردن به؛ توجه کردن به
englishDefinition: To deal with a problem, or to give something your attention.
example: The clinic was slow to attend to complaints about waiting times.
examplePersian: کلینیک در رسیدگی به شکایات مربوط به زمان انتظار کند بود.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: The total greenhouse gas emissions caused by an activity or person.
example: Reducing the carbon footprint of deliveries is now a design goal.
examplePersian: کاهش ردپای کربنی تحویل‌ها اکنون یک هدف طراحی است.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: To keep asking someone for something until they agree.
example: Reporters pestered her for a comment all afternoon.
examplePersian: خبرنگاران تمام عصر برای گرفتن اظهارنظر اصرار کردند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: شرح دادن؛ درصدد بودن؛ آغاز کردن
englishDefinition: To explain something clearly, or to begin a task.
example: The report sets out the arguments for and against the reform.
examplePersian: این گزارش استدلال‌های موافق و مخالف اصلاحات را شرح می‌دهد.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: Give a particular amount of something to someone.
example: Each member was allotted twenty minutes to speak.
examplePersian: به هر عضو بیست دقیقه برای صحبت اختصاص داده شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To have influence or importance in a decision.
example: The recommendation carried little weight with the ministry.
examplePersian: این توصیه‌نامه برای وزارتخانه وزن چندانی نداشت.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

persianMeaning: حرف اضافه، واژه‌ای که پیش از اسم می‌آید
englishDefinition: A word such as in, on or at that comes before a noun to show time, place or direction.
example: In this sentence the preposition shows how the two arguments are related.
examplePersian: در این جمله، حرف اضافه نشان می‌دهد که دو مفعول چگونه به هم مرتبط‌اند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To make something easier to understand.
example: A recent study sheds light on why the treatment works.
examplePersian: مطالعه‌ای اخیر توضیح می‌دهد که چرا این درمان مؤثر است.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: Showing strong feeling or enthusiasm.
example: She is an ardent supporter of the campaign.
examplePersian: او از حامیان پرشور این کمپین است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: پاسخگو بودن به؛ برآورده کردن نیاز کسی
englishDefinition: To provide for a particular group or a range of needs.
example: The new library caters for both young children and university students.
examplePersian: کتابخانهٔ جدید هم برای کودکان خردسال و هم برای دانشجویان خدمات فراهم می‌کند.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: Just able to be seen, heard or noticed.
persianMeaning: محسوس؛ به‌قدری که دیده یا شنیده شود
example: There was a perceptible improvement in her hearing after surgery.
examplePersian: پس از جراحی بهبود محسوسی در شنوایی او دیده شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Without having enough of something, or apart from something.
example: Short of a major breakthrough, the treatment will not improve.
examplePersian: جز یک پیشرفت بزرگ، این درمان بهبود نخواهد یافت.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: A state of nervous excitement and worry.
example: There was a rise in agitation among staff when pay was frozen.
examplePersian: وقتی دستمزدها ثابت شد، آشفتگی میان کارکنان بالا گرفت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: همزمان بودن با؛ مصادف بودن با
englishDefinition: To happen at the same time as something else.
example: The festival coincides with the start of the rainy season.
examplePersian: جشنواره با آغاز فصل باران مصادف است.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: Slow and heavy, especially in the way something moves or speaks.
example: His ponderous reply silenced the whole room.
examplePersian: پاسخ سنگین او کل اتاق را ساکت کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: جدا کردن؛ به‌طور خاص نام بردن از
englishDefinition: To treat or mention one person differently from the others.
example: It is unfair to single out one department for criticism.
examplePersian: انصاف نیست که تنها یک دپارتمان را مورد انتقاد قرار دهیم.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: Pleasant, acceptable or welcome.
example: We found the terms of the offer agreeable.
examplePersian: ما شرایط پیشنهاد را قابل قبول یافتیم.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: برخورد کردن با؛ به نظر رسیدن
englishDefinition: To meet or find something by chance, or to seem a certain way.
example: I came across an unusual phrase in an old textbook this morning.
examplePersian: امروز صبح به یک عبارت غیرمعمول در یک کتاب قدیمی برخوردم.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: Sad and complaining in a voice or sound.
example: She wrote a plaintive letter to her closest friend.
examplePersian: او نامه‌ای شکوه‌مند به نزدیک‌ترین دوستش نوشت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The likelihood that a result is not due to chance alone.
example: The effect showed statistical significance but was very small.
examplePersian: این اثر از نظر آماری معنادار بود اما بسیار کوچک بود.
collocations: below the threshold of statistical significance
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: Say that something is caused by or belongs to someone.
example: Historians ascribe the collapse to a series of poor harvests.
examplePersian: مورخان فروپاشی را به مجموعه‌ای از برداشت‌های ناموفق نسبت می‌دهند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To accept an unpleasant situation as real.
example: Many communities are still trying to come to terms with the closure of the factory.
examplePersian: بسیاری از جوامع هنوز در تلاش برای پذیرش تعطیلی کارخانه هستند.
collocations: struggle to come to terms with
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: A feeling of being completely confused about something.
example: He stared at the map in total perplexity.
examplePersian: او با سردرگمی کامل به نقشه خیره شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: سرچشمه گرفتن از؛ ناشی بودن از
englishDefinition: To develop or originate from something.
example: Much of the hostility stems from a lack of trust rather than from genuine disagreement.
examplePersian: بخش زیادی از خصومت از فقدان اعتماد ناشی می‌شود نه از اختلاف واقعی.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: Attach one word or letter to another to make a new word.
example: The prefix un- is affixed to the front of the word.
examplePersian: پیشوند آن- به ابتدای واژه چسبانده می‌شود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: برجسته شدن؛ به کانون توجه آمدن
englishDefinition: To become important or noticed after a period in the background.
example: Mental health has come to the fore since the pandemic.
examplePersian: از زمان همه‌گیری، سلامت روان به کانون توجه آمده است.
collocations: has recently come to the fore
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: A large board with writing on it, hung in a public place.
persianMeaning: تابلو؛ تختهٔ نوشته‌دار در مکان عمومی
example: Protesters held placards outside the ministry.
examplePersian: معترضان بیرون وزارتخانه تابلو گرفتند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Used in formal English to mean after something has happened.
example: Subsequent to the merger, staff numbers were reduced by a fifth.
examplePersian: پس از ادغام، تعداد کارکنان به یک‌پنجم کاهش یافت.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: Shock someone by being very surprising.
example: The scale of the ancient city astounded the archaeologists.
examplePersian: مقیاس آن شهر باستانی باستان‌شناسان را شگفت‌زده کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To obey a rule, standard or official request.
example: Most exporters complied with the new labelling rules before the deadline.
examplePersian: بیشتر صادرکنندگان پیش از مهلت، مقررات جدید برچسب‌گذاری را رعایت کردند.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: To treat someone badly over time because of their beliefs or group.
persianMeaning: آزار دادن؛ تحت فشار قرار دادن به‌خاطر باور
example: The minority was persecuted for its religious beliefs.
examplePersian: اقلیت به‌خاطر باورهای مذهبی‌اش آزار می‌دید.
